estimates.B.79: data/.b79/fits/ (main run, beam columns as delivered)

classes.gate: TG = TX where C_E >= 0.7, T0 otherwise (also where C_E is undefined)

check_stage.what: TX over T0, target L5, all rows; recomputed from the stored estimates against b75_availability.{md,json}
check_stage.pass_rule: point rounded to three decimals equals the value printed in b75_availability.md

spearman.population: D1 discharges with C_E and at least 50 S-set rows (L5); per-discharge skill of TX over T0 under S per re-partition; point = mean over the three re-partitions

G1.text: V1, S: TX over T0 in the high class minus that in the low class lies above zero

G2.text: V1, S: TE over T0 in the low class has an interval that contains zero or lies below it (the ECEI half adds nothing where its channels are not coherent)
G2.note: TB over T0 in the low class: +0.144; c [+0.046, +0.262]

G3.text: V1, S: TE over T0 in the high class lies above zero
G3.note: TB over T0 in the high class: +0.269; c [+0.204, +0.336]

G4.text: V1, D650: TX over T0 in the high class minus that in the low class lies above zero

G5.text: V1, S, blocks up to 32310 only: TX over T0 in the high class minus that in the low class lies above zero (the ordering holds inside the earlier blocks, not only between blocks)

G6.text: V3, S: TX over T0 in the high class lies above zero

G7.text: V1, S, block from 32312: TG over T0 lies above zero

G8.text: V4 (fit to 31991), S: TG over T0 lies above zero

G9.text: V1, S, all blocks: TG is not worse than TX (the interval of TG over TX is not below zero)
